svg.title: yolowzstd — INFORMATION THEORY × CACHE
svg.desc: Two symbols per table lookup. Moffat & Turpin (1997). P = Σ_l m(l) · Σ m(l′) [l + l′ ≤ 12] ≥ 45%. The gate is computed exactly from the code tree; the 16 KiB pair table (4096 × u32) is built lazily and reused by Repeat blocks. Limit code length, keep Kraft exact. Moffat & Katajainen (1995). Σ 2^L − depth = 2^L, L = 11. Clamp every depth, then lengthen and shorten codes until the budget is exactly full — zero heap allocation, tested on deep Fibonacci trees. Quantize with the least KL loss. Gross (1956) · Duda (2013) · RFC 8878. min −Σ c_i log₂(p_i / 2^L) s.t. Σ p_i = 2^L. Every move is integer cross-multiplication — no floats, no division. A symbol worth under half a cell gets the RFC “−1” marker. Reuse the old tree when KL is small. Shannon entropy · KL divergence. n·D_KL(p‖q) = n·H(p,q) − n·H(p) ≤ 280 bit. Decide before building: store raw when n·Ĥ cannot beat the bytes; reuse the previous tree when its extra cost stays under 280 bits. An online price list in ⅛-bit units. Zopfli · Zstd btultra. cost(s) = 8·(log₂Σc − log₂c_s), clamp 4…96. Priors start at 2× the RFC predefined counts, so the first block already has sane prices; decay ½ keeps the model local. Parse for bits, not for length. Zopfli · btultra · BT4 (Pavlov, Collet). D[i+ℓ] = min(D[i] + C_of + C_ml(ℓ) + C_ll). Literal costs telescope exactly (Δ = C(ll+1) − C(ll)), and each longer candidate only relaxes lengths above the previous one. Eight tag compares in one u64. SwissTable 2017 · Zstd row hash 2021 · Warren. x = row ⊕ splat(tag) → zero-byte mask. Hash 5-byte prefixes to dodge 4-gram Zipf saturation; a separate exact 4-byte near table has zero false positives. Skip faster as the evidence grows. Wald (1945) sequential analysis. step = 2 + ((i − anchor) ≫ 4). Wald’s idea read as a rule of thumb: a longer miss run is stronger evidence of incompressible data, so probe wider.
